candidates.title: DWR Well Water Level
candidates.description: The Division of Water Resources, in cooperation with various local groundwater management districts and partners, operates a statewide network to monitor groundwater levels.

candidates.title: DWR Water Right - Transactions
candidates.description: A Water Right is a property right that is either conditional or absolute and conveys the right to use a particular amount of water, with a specified priority date as confirmed by the water court. The Transaction List contains the the court decreed actions that affect amount and use(s) that can be used by each water right.

candidates.title: DWR Water Right - Net Amounts
candidates.description: A Water Right is a property right that is either conditional or absolute and conveys the right to use a particular amount of water, with a specified priority date as confirmed by the water court.  The Net Amounts List contains the current status of a water right based on all of  its court decreed actions.
